test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options including disable function signatures and custom docstrings
test_disable_function_signatures: test that pybind11 options disable function signatures so docstrings are empty
test_custom_docstring: test that a custom docstring is applied to a pybind11 bound function
test_overloaded_docstrings: test docstring behavior on overloaded pybind11 functions with one or both overloads documented
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that user-defined docstrings are suppressed for pybind11 functions and class attributes
